comparison.objective: Use two pry bars to break a seized pulley loose and remove it, not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tool placement, coordinated high-force prying, regrasping, and extraction versus fine hex-key/collar manipulation and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Pulley freed and removed; body only names the directory, with no spec versions or force/damage rubric. Candidate requires preserving hardware while achieving repeated bounded stopping behavior.
comparison.reason: High-force seizure release and removal are meaningfully different from fine iterative calibration and relocking.
